description: Walking home from school: all of SERIFU/GEKO.BIN (base 0x80197000; game-internals 6n), 996 of 1,011 strings (492 distinct texts; repeats share one copy). The pure-punctuation pauses ("‥‥‥‥‥。") stay Japanese and the empty placeholder strings are left alone. Twelve sections: one per girl (girl ids 0-10 map to sections 1,5,2,3,9,6,7,4,0,8,11) plus section 10, the player's own thoughts. Each girl's section: she waits and asks (1-5), the player calls out and she agrees (6-11), she has plans (12-17), she runs off (18-21), "And then..." (22), the talk on the way by topic (23-38: exams, culture fest, sports day, school trip, New Year, birthday, holidays, moving up, graduation), the closing thought (39), and a few girl-specific extras. Codes: 00 player, 01 girl, 08 action choice (even letter counts per option), 06 thought (the game draws both brackets, so no parentheses and an even last run), 07 narration, 0C/0D two girl strings in one box. {G} counts 18 cells, so lines with a name are short. Verified in DuckStation with tools/emu/force_walk.py from the 95/4/23 Sunday state: Shiori rank 0 with the exams topic, Yuko rank 2 with the four-line winter-break topic, Mira rank 2 and 3, Megumi rank 4. Checked only statically: the other seven girls' sections, declined invitations and regret thoughts, the other topics, girl-specific extras, natural triggers.
